import sys

def count_even_runs(s, idx):
    if idx >= len(s):
        return 0
    end = idx
    while end < len(s) and s[end] == s[idx]:
        end += 1
    run_len = end - idx
    add = 1 if run_len % 2 == 0 else 0
    return add + count_even_runs(s, end)

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    print(count_even_runs(s, 0))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
